# Narrow PR E2E selection for verified example-local CSS

## Context

The example-local CSS slice of D#21725 was approved against the 21 November 2026 06:45:33 UTC body. Five exact-merge-tree counterfactuals selected 11 E2E shard jobs where the actual runs started 75. Three runs were red. The counterfactual selections retained the specs containing all five observed failures. The replay measured selection, with hosted timing and regression-detection lag still to measure. [Discussion](https://github.com/orgs/neomjs/discussions/21725)

Maintainer work because this changes selection behind required CI.

## The Problem

A stylesheet used by one standalone example currently starts the full Engine E2E tier. The classifier puts all of `resources/css/` in the foundation fallback. That is safe for shared CSS. A uniquely owned example stylesheet can instead use the same browser reach evidence as its example entry.

## The Architectural Reality

`e2eSpecReach` binds specs to application entries and source reach. `selectSpecs` evaluates changed paths against `FOUNDATION` before narrower rules, then includes the existing unnamed-spec controls. The hosted tier further filters the selected paths. A spec from another tier cannot serve as an owning witness. Relevant pushes run the full tier when admitted. [Reach map](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/8258d557ad0bc4e341e4d4aa2e5a9152c697a56c/buildScripts/util/e2eSpecReach.mjs) · [Selection](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/8258d557ad0bc4e341e4d4aa2e5a9152c697a56c/buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs) · [Workflow](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/8258d557ad0bc4e341e4d4aa2e5a9152c697a56c/.github/workflows/classify-test-scope.yml)

The PR files response includes status and previous filename. The workflow currently forwards only normalized path strings to the selector. A rename can therefore look like a tracked, eligible destination while dropping the old stylesheet from the input.

## The Fix

Use the existing application-entry lookup and spec reach map to evaluate a stylesheet before the blanket CSS fallback. Narrow only when its owning standalone example and theme consumer are verified, an actual Engine-tier browser spec reaches the owner, and the stylesheet has no external consumer. Check both explicit `additionalThemeFiles` references and imports that mount the mirrored class. Keep the existing selection for all other changed files and the unnamed controls. Include the relevant source path and status for moves and removals. Select the full tier whenever either side of a move or any other ownership evidence is uncertain.

The selector retains other edits and the existing unnamed controls. Moves and removals retain their relevant path evidence. | Shared, missing, ambiguous or insufficiently covered inputs select the full tier. | AC-1 and AC-2 |
| Required E2E result | Existing Engine Tests workflow and ruleset | Preserve required context names, exact-head association, result provenance and full admitted `dev` runs. | Current full-matrix path. | AC-2 and AC-3 |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1. A uniquely owned stylesheet selects its owner’s executed browser specs and the existing unnamed controls. A stylesheet whose only named owning spec is excluded from the Engine tier selects the full tier.
- [ ] AC-2. `Global.css`, `board/Card.css`, the shared ConfigurationViewport, and Dashboard Palette with external theme consumers select the full tier. An otherwise eligible stylesheet with an external `additionalThemeFiles` consumer selects the full tier. Include a cross-application mirrored-class import as an ownership control. Removed and renamed CSS have controls, including a rename outside the current E2E path boundary. A mixed CSS and Engine diff retains every spec the Engine edit reaches.
- [ ] AC-3. Replay the five recorded examples against the revised selector, with the exact changed files and merge trees. Report selected specs and shards. Retain all five observed failures’ specs. Existing required contexts and exact-head checks stay intact. An admitted `dev` push still uses the full tier.
- [ ] AC-4. Post-merge, measure push-to-required-green and per-job queue wait on three examples, using the completed #21541 receipts as the baseline. For any regression with an attributable `dev` merge, report merge-to-first-red before and after when comparable evidence exists. Record unknowns explicitly. [Timing baseline](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21541#issuecomment-7065278169) · [Detection-lag residual](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/21725#discussioncomment-19795016)

## Out of Scope

Changing shard ceilings or runner groups, age-based admission, required check names, body-edit workflows, and full-matrix selection for admitted `dev` pushes.

## Avoided Traps

An `examples/` prefix alone can match shared styles. A mirrored path alone can miss a consumer that loads a theme namespace explicitly. A spec appearing in a source map does not prove it runs in Engine CI.
